tasks.title: Run complete bridge journeys offline after preparation
tasks.goal: Verify both bridge products through external adapters with every required resource/action present.
steps: Bind the accepted external captures and complete prepared resource/action closure from M-09-A/B/C.
Execute required bridge workflows through M-08 external adapters in isolated consumers; after preparation deny network and inspect actual output/state.
Record unsupported/missing steps and exact resource membership; compare original foreign payload bytes/notices after the journey.
positive_cases: Prepared offline journey succeeds for each required bridge procedure.
Actual external adapter effects match the reviewed grant and receipt.
negative_cases: Missing nested resource, hidden network fetch or an unimplemented action blocks acceptance.
Diagnostic-only output cannot replace a required executable journey.

tasks.commit_subject: test(bridges): verify complete prepared offline journeys
notes: External logical roots are unbound authoring metadata. Before execution, the root must provide isolated checkouts for external:org.speckit.speckit and/or external:com.external-skills.skills and verify their exact captures. Never write the currently existing sibling source trees. External package checks are taken from that checkout's own declared commands; no unverified command is claimed here.

tasks.title: Integrate local derivatives with native reuse journeys
tasks.goal: Prove the combined source→derivative→adapter→existing-code execution path without inherited authority.
steps: Consume M-10-D and select a bridge resource and native profile resource for independently owned local derivatives.
Inspect base/local/result provenance, explicitly admit downstream effects, then execute the native reuse journey through M-03/M-04.
Revoke/alter the derivative binding and verify stale or unauthorized actions refuse while retained original evidence remains readable.
positive_cases: A sealed-compatible or separately targeted local fork is usable under its own identity.
Current-source verification remains linked to exact derivative/origin captures.
negative_cases: Upstream grants/signatures cannot authorize derivative execution.
Missing one mandatory derivative or current-source evidence case prevents completion.
